overview: This event ties together olf operations, local course rules, and home-field arrival in a way that should already make sense before you step. You should be ready to brief what changes the plan, what numbers matter, and where the usual errors start once the workload climbs.

General Notes
PT SHAMROCK is the common reporting point for most arrivals.
Home-Field Arrival is judged by how well you enter it, stay ahead of the aircraft, and recover without needing cleanup coaching.
Know the entry airspeed, altitude, configuration, and cockpit setup before you start the maneuver.
Fly 240 KIAS until PT SHAMROCK (unless directed otherwise).
Contact Corpus Approach on CH 8 UHF unless otherwise directed.
The usual trap is missing the setup picture, then trying to salvage Home-Field Arrival late.
